_comment: Applications tested for real. "status": "laboratory-validated" when tested in the ProxMenux lab; "community_tested" with the tester's GitHub user, the date and a link to the report when tested by the community. Read when the catalog loads and applied on top of the generated templates and the overlays, so a new entry shows without regenerating and a regeneration keeps it. oci/VALIDATION.md is generated from this file.
